clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Demisette Cloyce teaches warlocks beneath the Slaughtered Lamb. She guides students in fel magic and sends those ready for more toward other summoners.

Warlocks gather in the cellar beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, while the city's authorities uphold order and the Holy Light. Demisette Cloyce lives in the catacombs below, teaching those willing to study forbidden arts. She warns that dark energies corrupt only those without the discipline to master them.

Demisette guides warlocks beyond Stormwind when they have gained enough mastery. She connects them with summoners such as Menara Voidrender in the Barrens, where they can seek potent artifacts and learn to bind formidable fel steeds.
